question: Neel wants to use a Character Printer. Which among the following should he pick?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dot Matrix Printer.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Printer is an **output device**.
 
• Dot matrix printers, also known as pin printers, are the most popular type of **impact printer.**
 
• These printers have a matrix of pins on their print heads to create **characters or graphics.** 
 
• Dot-matrix printers usually have **9 to 24 pins** in the print head.
 
• Dot-matrix printers are **cheap **and usually print 100–600 characters per second. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Drum Printer-**

 
 
• Drum printer is a type of **impact printer**.
 
• The drum printer consists of a rotating cylindrical drum with a circular band of characters on its surface.
 
• In particular, the surface is divided into tracks equal to the size of the supported printing paper.
 
• Drum Printer printing speed is quite fast ( 300 - 2,000 lines per minute), they make a lot of noise. 
 
 
 
• **Laser Printer-**
 
 
• Laser printers are **non-impact printers,** typically using laser or non-impact photocopier technology to produce the dots needed to print text or images on paper.
 
• Laser printers can produce extremely high-resolution prints.
 
• This can vary from 300 dpi (Dots Per Inch) to 1200 dpi depending on system capacity and memory availability. 
 
 
 
• **Chain Printer-**
 
 
• Chain printer is a type of **impact printer**.
 
• The chain printer consists of a revolving chain with characters set on its surface. These printers typically have a character set of **48, 64, or 96 characters.**
 
• Chain printer can print 300 - 500 **lines of characters per minute.**
